title: A Code on the Spanish Steps
synopsis: A new owl card sends you to the Spanish Steps.
The Owl leaves a secret code in chalk.
And the show's smiling sponsor has a story to tell.
goal: Read the Owl's code, check the sponsor's story, and open the Owl's box.

notes: Letter: the Owl's card about the steps (top, bottom, middle, just above).

learning.objective: at the top, at the bottom, in the middle, just above를 읽고 계단 아래에서 위로 장소를 놓는다.
expressions: The church is at the very top.
My sign is just above the flowers.

play.title: Up the Steps
story: This morning, an owl card was under Giulia's door.
It sent you to the Spanish Steps, 135 wide stone steps.
People sit on them and eat gelato in the sun.
play.letter:
The church is at the very top of the steps.
The boat fountain is at the very bottom.
The flower pots are in the middle.
My sign is just above the flowers.
— The Owl
play.question: Put the places in order, from the bottom of the steps to the top.
hints: Just above the flowers means right after them, going up.
play.successMessage: You climbed the steps the right way!
transition: Boat, flowers, the Owl's sign, church.
Just above the flower pots, you find a little owl drawn in chalk.
Under it are seven strange letters.
play.orderFeedback: Start at the bottom. Read middle and just above again.

clue.title: Up the Steps
clue.note: The Owl's sign is just above the flower pots on the Spanish Steps.

evidence.name: The Owl's Steps Card
evidence.description: The owl card that was under Giulia's door.
evidence.inscription: My sign is just above the flowers.

discovery.title: THE CHALK OWL
discovery.detail: Just above the flower pots, the Owl drew a sign. Under it: seven strange letters.

notes: Letter: the Owl's chalk code UVFTEBZ, each letter moved forward by one. Back by one: TUESDAY.

clueInputs.note: The sign just above the flowers.

learning.objective: 한 글자씩 뒤로 옮기는 암호를 풀어 요일 Tuesday를 쓴다.
expressions: Move each letter back by one.
Watch the man who borrowed the piece.

play.title: The Chalk Code
story: The chalk owl has big round eyes.
Under it, the Owl wrote a code, and how to read it.
play.letter:
UVFTEBZ

How to read it: B means A. C means B. D means C.
Move each letter back by one.
Watch the man who borrowed the piece on this day.
— The Owl
play.question: What does the Owl's code say?
hints: U moves back to T. V moves back to U.
The word is a day of the week.
transition: "Someone borrowed the piece on Tuesday?" says Giulia.
Then a big, smiling man in a fine suit walks down the steps to you.

feedback.UVFTEBZ: That is the code itself. Move each letter back by one.
feedback.THURSDAY: Check the letters one by one. U moves back to T. V moves back to U.

play.orderFeedback: Those letters are right. Check their order in the code.

clue.title: The Owl's Code
clue.note: The Owl says: watch the man who borrowed the piece on Tuesday.

evidence.name: The Chalk Code
evidence.description: The Owl's code in chalk, above the flower pots.
evidence.inscription: UVFTEBZ — move each letter back by one.

discovery.title: A DAY: TUESDAY
discovery.detail: Someone borrowed the piece on Tuesday. The Owl says: watch that person.

options.label: Yes. Aldo wanted the piece, so he took it.
options.feedback: Wanting a thing is not taking it. Where was Aldo at midnight?

options.label: Yes. Aldo can carry heavy boxes.
options.feedback: Aldo's back hurts. And where was he at midnight?

options.label: No. At midnight on Friday, Aldo was in Hall B.

notes: Recall: the Hall B door log (Case 06). Letter: Bruno's story about Aldo, which cannot be true.

clueInputs.note: Hall B's door log: Aldo was there at midnight.

learning.objective: 후원자의 진술을 이전 증거(출입 기록)와 비교해 거짓임을 판단한다.
expressions: I saw Professor Aldo carry a heavy box.

play.title: The Smiling Sponsor
story: The man stops in front of you, all smiles.
play.letter:
"On Friday at midnight, I walked past the museum.
I saw Professor Aldo at the back door.
He carried a heavy box out of the museum!
He wanted that piece so much. It was him, I am sure."
play.question: Is Signor Valli telling the truth?
hints: Check your Notebook. Where was Aldo at midnight on Friday?
Could Aldo be in two places at the same time?
play.successMessage: You caught a story that is not true!
transition: Why would the sponsor tell a story that is not true?
On his card, there is a little gold crane.

clue.title: A Story That Is Not True
clue.note: Bruno Valli said Aldo carried a box out at midnight. Aldo was in Hall B. Why did he say it?

evidence.name: Bruno's Business Card
evidence.description: Signor Valli's card. There is a little crane on it.
evidence.inscription: VALLI BUILDING · We build Rome's future!

recall.title: Check his story
recall.prompt: Which thing in your Notebook shows where Aldo was at midnight?
recall.miss: Look for the log of Friday night at the university.

lines.text: Bruno Valli! I pay for the museum's show.
I want to help you, Detective.
Listen. I saw something on Friday night.
Hall B? Well... maybe I saw wrong.
It was very dark, you know.
He gives you his card and walks away fast.

discovery.title: A STORY THAT IS NOT TRUE
discovery.detail: Aldo was in Hall B at midnight. So why did Signor Valli blame him?

notes: The Owl's box at the top: 4 places on the steps, Tuesday is day 2, 7 letters in the code word.

clueInputs.note: Four places on the way up.
Tuesday is day 2; the code word has 7 letters.

learning.objective: 오늘 찾은 단서(장소 수, 요일 번호, 글자 수)로 427을 맞춘다.
expressions: Which day of the week is in my code?
How many letters are in my code word?

play.title: The Box by the Church
story: At the very top, by the church, there is a small box with three dials.
It has an owl stamp on the lid.
Far down the side steps, a young woman with an owl ring is watching you.
play.letter:
Three numbers from today:
First: How many places did you put in order on the steps?
Second: Which day is in my code? Monday is day 1.
Third: How many letters are in my code word?
— The Owl
play.question: Turn the dials to the Owl's three numbers. Then open the box.
hints: Count the places from the boat fountain to the church.
Count the days from Monday. Then count the letters of the day.
transition: The young woman with the owl ring is gone.
Under the page is one more owl card.
At last, the Owl wants to meet you.

feedback.327: Count the places on the steps again. The Owl's sign is one of them.
feedback.426: Count the letters of the code word again.
feedback.437: Tuesday is day 2. Count from Monday.

play.orderFeedback: All three numbers fit. Places first, then the day, then the letters.

evidence.name: The Loan Book Page
evidence.description: A copy of the museum lab's loan book, from the Owl's box.
evidence.inscription: TUESDAY · 2 PM to 5 PM · For poster photos · Signed: B.V.

ending.text: Four, two, seven. The box opens!
ending.speaker: giulia_marino

ending.text: Inside is a copied page from the lab's loan book.

intro: This morning, an owl card was under Giulia's door.
"The Spanish Steps hold my next sign," it said.
"The Owl is watching us," says Giulia. "But who is it?"
play.caseSummary: The Owl's chalk code said TUESDAY. Bruno Valli, the show's sponsor, said he saw Aldo with a box at midnight. But Aldo was in Hall B. The Owl's box held a page of the loan book. On Tuesday, B.V. took the piece out of the lab for three hours.

notes: Bruno is suspicious from here, but nothing yet proves the swap: the season reveals him in Case 11.
The loan book page (s3_ep07_e4) is the first link of Bruno's plan, put in order in Case 11.

STEP 3-14: puzzles kept (an order on the steps, a code, a story checked against the Hall B log, a dial). Valli's talks, Discovery Moments and an ending added; the owl card in the box is the one read in Case 08 M1.
